name: scheduled-chat-continuation-gate
principle: A local job or transport failure is not a run stop condition. Preserve the affected result or spillover job seed in any available durable transport, then continue independent research whenever safe. External fallback recovery converges through the immutable GitHub fallback intake before reusable transport files are touched.

fallback_policy.rule: Fallbacks are independent durable outboxes. A failure or backlog in one must not stop research while another durable path can accept the complete logical payload or offline job seed. On recovery, Drive and Library submit immutable envelopes to GitHub fallback-inbox; only the serialized survey-helper dispatcher expands them into reusable transport files.

backlog_policy.rule: Record-bank count, Drive pending count, Library pending count, GitHub fallback-inbox count, and unsent-paper count are transport-state metrics, not research-capacity limits.

probe_success.action: checkpoint only the affected complete logical payload through fallback routing, leave its GitHub job incomplete, continue independent work, and allow later unrelated GitHub writes

probe_failure.action: disable further GitHub writes for the remainder of this run; checkpoint each completed payload through fallback routing; when normal GitHub ready work is exhausted, continue from fallback spillover candidates or create an offline job seed and keep researching

fallback_failure_protocol.google_drive_failed: mark Drive unavailable for the relevant scope and try ChatGPT Library; do not stop if Library can durably save the logical payload
fallback_failure_protocol.chatgpt_library_failed: mark Library unavailable for the relevant scope and try Google Drive; do not stop if Drive can durably save the logical payload
fallback_failure_protocol.source_recovery_failed: leave the source pending and continue other research or other recovery paths; never treat one replay failure as a global stop
fallback_failure_protocol.duplicate_intake: if the same envelope id and content already exists in GitHub fallback-inbox/archive, acknowledge the source copy without re-dispatching it
fallback_failure_protocol.id_conflict: quarantine only the conflicting envelope; do not overwrite the GitHub ledger and do not stop unrelated work
fallback_failure_protocol.both_external_fallbacks_failed: continue only while GitHub direct write can durably preserve required state; otherwise STOP_RUN before producing an uncheckpointed completed result or undispatchable offline seed

end_of_run_gate.rule: Before emitting a final response or ending voluntarily, evaluate stop_run_only_if after considering GitHub actionable ready jobs, checkpointed jobs, fallback spillover candidates, GitHub fallback-intake work, and the ability to create a new offline job seed. Unsent-paper count, any fallback backlog size, a dirty bank, exhaustion of all fixed banks, or a single recovery-path failure does not satisfy STOP_RUN while at least one durable transport remains writable and independent research can continue.
